test_id: body template transformation boundary unresolved expression output remains the exact authored string

findings.rationale: The NLSpec explicitly requires existing unresolved-expression behavior to remain unchanged in section 3.2 and Definition of Done 6.5. The implementation also attempts that behavior at transformer.ts:14 by returning the original authored string when a standalone expression evaluates to undefined. Therefore this repeated failure does not reveal missing or ambiguous specification; it indicates an implementation or integration defect that must be diagnosed from the detailed test failure.
